# Piixpal

> Pixel characters that live on your website: drop-in web components, zero dependencies, free and open source (MIT).

## Install (pick one)
- Script tag: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/piixpal@0.4/piixpal.min.js"></script> then use the tags anywhere.
- One component only: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/piixpal@0.4/dist/c/NAME.min.js"></script>
- npm: npm install piixpal; React: import { PiixPal } from "piixpal/react"; <PiixPal pal="bitbug" />. Vue: app.use(Piixpal) from "piixpal/vue". Anything else: import "piixpal" in browser code.
- shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/NAME.json, then import { Name } from "@/components/piixpal/NAME".
- No markup: <script src="…/piixpal.min.js" data-pals="bitbug@h1, boing@footer"></script>

## Rules
- A pal lives on the element it is placed inside (or on="css selector"). It never blocks clicks.
- box="selector" keeps any pal inside one element.
- Pals are browser-only; in Next.js use the React wrappers or shadcn components (they are client components).
- Docs and live demos: https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/components/

## Components
- Bitbug: A lime beetle that crawls along the real outline of your letters. Tag: <piix-pal pal="bitbug">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/bitbug.json
- Boing: A jelly drop that bounces on your footer and lands with a splat. Tag: <piix-pal pal="boing">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/boing.json
- Moss: A mushroom that sits on your text reading its book, ignoring you (mostly). Tag: <piix-pal pal="moss">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/moss.json
- Lurk: A shy creature that peeks over the edge of your cards. Tag: <piix-pal pal="lurk">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/lurk.json
- Thread: A spider that dangles from your nav on a long thread. Tag: <piix-pal pal="thread">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/thread.json
- Pip: A round bird that hops between your buttons and perches on them. Tag: <piix-pal pal="pip">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/pip.json
- Bumble: A fuzzy bee that buzzes about your element. Tag: <piix-pal pal="bumble">. shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/bumble.json
